_readme: One settings file for every safety check. Edit this, not the individual configs. Round 1 (2026-11-12, Starky's choice): logic = the files that were already logic (shared data + backup code, each notebook's model/util/storage files). The Eye's logic is still inside the-eye/app.js and comes out into tested files in later rounds. Each notebook's data/shared/ folder is a byte-for-byte copy of shared/data/ made by tools/sync.py shared, so shared/data/ stands for all five.

returningVisitor._readme: The button clicker runs each page twice: as a first visit (empty storage, so the welcome cards come up after about 900 ms, hence firstVisitWaitMs) and as a returning visitor, with these saved so the welcome cards stay away and it reaches the notebook itself. The Eye asks for the photographer's details once, on first launch, and shows a tip the first time each tab opens, so those are marked as seen too. modalSelectors: while one of these is open the clicker only uses what's inside it (The Eye's popups are .modal-overlay without aria-modal).
